newsitem.title: FRANCE: Small accident during repairs at Elf Donges plant.
newsitem.headline: Small accident during repairs at Elf Donges plant.

text.p: An accident ripped the top off a storage tank at Elf Aquitaine's Donges refinery in western France on Wednesday, spreading fumes and disrupting rail traffic, but no-one was hurt, the oil company said.
Production at the 210,000 barrels per day (bpd) oil plant in western France was not affected since most of the plant had already been shut earlier this week for routine maintenance.
The accident happened when workers mistakenly pumped water into a tank already containing 15,000 cubic metres of oil product kept at high temperature, refinery officials said.
The resulting build-up in pressure blew the top away from the tank and sent clouds of vapour into the air, they said.
Nearby train services were suspended for one and a half hours before starting up again around midday.
"There has been some material damage but no-one was injured and there is no effect whatsover on production," an Elf spokesman in Paris said.
The accident took place in a part of the refinery used for distilling light oil products, he said.

Two of the refinery's basic operating areas, the crude distillation unit (CDU) and the atmospheric distillation unit (ADU), were taken out of action this week for regular repairs scheduled to last until the first week of March.
